up-decay.html: The run the book’s Gangrel make when the full moon pulls them out to hunt with the wolves. Spirits see a vampire in wolf-shape running beside the packs, and they don’t know what to call it. Decker drinks Lupine Vitae in secret. The spirits have noticed even if the Garou haven’t.

up-raid.name: The Eagle raid-road
up-raid.html: The weekly route of the Eagle raids: east to the lake, north up the shore under the Lake Breeze, and into the city through the parks, just as the book says Lupines do.

up-iron.name: The Iron Horse’s road
up-iron.html: The chrome pack’s favourite run: down Juneau Avenue to the Crucible, where the Blood Brothers drink. Now the Horse runs it every night, looking for Akawa.

gt-deep-mke.name: Deep Tunnel · Milwaukee branch
gt-deep-mke.html: An ultra-deep storage tunnel under the river bed, under construction since 1986: three hundred feet down in dolomite. Workers have seen tracks that were “too big” here and abandoned one of the side drifts.
gt-deep-mke.src: The MMSD Deep Tunnel is real (built 1986–1993); the rest is improvised.

gt-deep-men.name: Deep Tunnel · Menomonee branch
gt-deep-men.html: The western branch under the Menomonee Valley. Halfway along is the abandoned drift where the vozhd sleeps.
gt-deep-men.src: The MMSD Deep Tunnel is real (built 1986–1993); the rest is improvised.

gt-deep-kk.name: Deep Tunnel · Kinnickinnic branch
gt-deep-kk.html: The southern branch under the concrete river. Its end breaks into the culverts where Drake hides.
gt-deep-kk.src: The MMSD Deep Tunnel is real (built 1986–1993); the rest is improvised.

gt-wis.name: The Wisconsin Avenue trunk sewer
gt-wis.html: The main brick artery under the avenue. The Nosferatu call it the Spine.

gt-river.name: The riverbank interceptor
gt-river.html: A sewer along the river’s west bank: from the North Avenue dam through the Grand Warrens to the Third Ward.

gt-valley.name: The valley interceptor
gt-valley.html: The sewer under the Menomonee Valley. The eastern half is still passable; the western half belongs to the creatures.

gt-north.name: The North Avenue sewer
gt-north.html: The old northern sewer. Quiet, and nearly empty.

gt-kk.name: The Kinnickinnic Avenue sewer
gt-kk.html: South, under Bay View. Maximus kept his stores along here.

gt-steam1.name: Steam passage · MECCA to the Hyatt

gt-steam2.name: Steam passage · to City Hall
gt-steam2.html: A service passage to the basements of City Hall and the Pfister.

gt-chestnut.name: The Chestnut Street cellars
gt-chestnut.html: Old lagering cellars under the Pabst brewery hill.

gt-parovich.name: Parovich’s old passage
gt-parovich.html: The former Primogen’s private passage from the Warrens to his mansion. Bricked up at both ends. At the western end the bricks have been broken out from inside.

gt-harbor.name: The passage to the lock
gt-harbor.html: A Nosferatu passage from the Grand Warrens to the old lock on the harbour shore.

gt-pocket.name: The way under the lake
gt-pocket.html: A stone passage on no engineer’s drawings. It starts in the harbour lock and slopes down under the lake bed to the Pocket’s Undersea Door. Closed since Parovich went over to the Sabbat.

gt-wide.name: Dragos’s wide tunnel
gt-wide.html: A tunnel a truck wide, dug (or grown) by Dragos’s creatures from the Cudahy warehouses to the workshops under the valley. Its southern mouth is hidden only by a warehouse wall.

au3.name: County Stadium on a good night

au12.name: 100 East Wisconsin, over the lost Pabst

merik.name: Terence Merik
merik.html: Born in Kent in 1645, an Earl Embraced by a nameless Countess. He took the city in 1930 on Canadian liquor money and Mafia muscle, and kept the Lupines fighting each other through his Gangrel wife Erica. A frenzy killed a couple on a park bench and then Erica, and he split in two: one half hired the Mask to catch the killer, the other kept killing. The Mask destroyed him in his burning house.

gracis.name: Gracis Nostinus
gracis.html: A soft, pink, five-foot Roman Embraced in 412 by Marius. He has hunted Hrothulf for 1,500 years to avenge their sire and Rome. He is the closest thing the Council has to a chairman and can always force a 3–3 stalemate. He wants the throne mainly so he can destroy Hrothulf, and the other clans know it.

hrothulf.name: Hrothulf
hrothulf.sub: Former Prince, recluse of the Outlands
hrothulf.html: A 5th-century Dane Embraced by Marius, whom he later slew and diablerized. He was Prince twice and stepped down twice to deny Gracis a target. He controls the fire department. He does not want the throne but will seize it temporarily if Gracis attacks openly. Parovich planned to put him on the Council to make it collapse; with Parovich gone, Gracis wonders who else had the same idea.

lucina.name: Lucina
lucina.html: A Missouri farm girl Embraced in 1879 and abandoned by her sire as “mediocre.” She is a fanatic for art as the cure for the Beast. Her ghouls guard museums and concert halls against Anarchs, and she is angling for the police administration to crush the gangs.

scott.name: Sir Edward Scott
scott.html: A 15th-century Cornish knight who turned up to Council in a bathrobe, a leather jacket or a bikini. He was the Anarchs’ voice on the Council and kept colleagues in line with duel challenges nobody accepted. He never remembered that he Embraced Akawa in 1770. Scott died in the chaos of the Sabbat invasion; the accounts of how differ, and no two agree.

jason.name: Jason
jason.html: A death-row prisoner Embraced in 1903 by Jacob the night before his hanging. He is quiet, mimics whoever speaks to him and checks his pocket watch. He holds the Council’s balance of power. He always distrusted the colour of Parovich’s aura and is the only Elder who said so before the invasion. He is watching Jade.

parovich.name: Parovich
parovich.sub: Former Nosferatu Primogen, exposed Sabbat agent (destroyed)
parovich.html: A vast, perfumed Russian with a forked tongue, in the city for ninety years. He saw the Sabbat take New York and joined the Black Hand. He owned the police detectives, backed a seventh Ventrue seat to wreck the Council, wanted Decker dead and hunted his own fleeing childer. During the failed Sabbat invasion he was exposed as the Sabbat’s patsy and destroyed. His Council seat stands empty.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: Parovich is not gone. His body and mind were melted into a Tzimisce vozhd hiding in the tunnels under the city, and a shred of his memory and will still lives in that monstrous flesh, remembering every secret of the Warrens.

carna.name: Carna
carna.html: Once Prince of Marseille, now over 600 and tired of intrigue. She is the official head of the Tremere here but took her orders from Victor, who relayed Mortius’s needs. With Victor dead, the Chapel works without Vienna’s direct oversight and draws on unorthodox resources ever more freely. She kills the lovers who “betray” her with her own Curse of Clytaemnestra, and she is coming unhinged. She secretly favours Hrothulf.

victor.name: Victor
victor.html: A CIA killer Embraced in 1950 by the Greek noble he was sent to murder. He held the real authority over Milwaukee’s Tremere, under orders to kill anyone who tried to control the anomaly’s prize, or perhaps to take it himself. He was killed by Drake, a corrupted Garou of the Mouse pack, who got inside the Chapel. Since then the Chapel has worked without Vienna’s direct oversight.

mortius.name: Dr. Mortius
mortius.html: A hunchbacked 16th-century mortal sorcerer whose rediscovery of magic earned him the Embrace. He shows visitors useless gadgets such as a “far-seeing tube” and secretly uses the Church of Isis as his dowsers; Kayla is his eyes inside the Brujah. Since Victor’s death nobody in Vienna checks his work, and the four-anchor ritual is his.

louis.name: Louis Detonas
louis.html: A French noble rescued from the guillotine in 1793. He has lived in Milwaukee longer than almost anyone and despises the lower classes who killed his parents. He considers Gracis and Lucina nearly friends.

barth.name: Barth (“Derik Dark”)
barth.html: A skinny Louisiana storyteller with a magnificent voice, Embraced in 1934. His show (10 p.m.–2 a.m., weeknights) is a public service for the Damned. He tips Lucina off about Anarch plans and fears the Union wants his blood.

akawa.name: Akawa
akawa.html: A Plains warrior Embraced in 1770 by a fleeing stranger he now knows was Sir Edward Scott. He rode with his gang in wolf form and kept no haven. His plan was to unify every gang, mortal and Kindred, control the city’s vessels and starve the Elders into crowning him Prince. In the chaos of the invasion he was taken (who did it, nobody quite knows), and the leaderless Blood Brothers are in turmoil.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: The Council holds him, in a cell in the steam tunnels under MECCA.

wrecker.name: Wrecker (Lewis)
wrecker.html: A ganger Embraced in 1968, with a black hog with flames on the tank and a tire iron. Cocky, violent and not bright. With Akawa gone he is trying to hold the Brothers together alongside Ethan Stone, and he plays chicken with anyone who questions the gang.

turk.name: Turk
turk.html: A street kid since 1967, Embraced in 1975 by the Chicago Anarch Gengis. He diablerized a rival gang’s leader. Merik Dominated him into a pawn, and Esau now whispers that every Kindred in the city is out to get him. He is terrified of fire.

decker.name: Mark Decker
decker.html: A Revolutionary War militiaman Embraced in 1777. He carries silver buckshot and a secret taste for Werewolf vitae. He has six to nine Kindred under him and many friendly suburban cops. He could seal every road out of the city, and the Sabbat wanted him dead first. It failed. Jade Riley now sleeps inside his patrol zone, and he hasn’t decided what that means.

thomas.name: Thomas Gerhieren
thomas.html: Embraced at sixteen in 1971 by Wendy, who was taken by Werewolves soon after. Twenty years with Decker. If Decker falls, Thomas will lead the Anubi’s revenge.

julia.name: Julia Calvin
julia.html: A hit-woman hired to kill Decker in 1989 who ended up his childe, Blood Bound and in love. If he dies, she may be the only one who can stop the Anubi from going after his killer.

jacob.name: Jacob / Esau
jacob.html: One ancient (Embraced A.D. 750) with two warring personalities. Each recruits pawns against the other, Jacob as a fatherly gentleman and Esau as something hairier. Neither starts the city’s feuds, but both pour gasoline on every one, and insane ghouls of theirs roam loose.

milo.name: Milo
milo.html: Banished from Chicago after his sire drank him through an acid trip in an asylum. He sleeps in drains and burned-out buildings and insists something in the lakeshore pipes will eat them all.

anastasia.name: Anastasia
anastasia.html: Once the prettiest girl in school, until a car wreck and then Parovich. She hides with her stray cats and keeps asking whether you like her hair. She took the news of her sire’s destruction in silence, and doesn’t believe it.

kristian.name: Kristian
kristian.html: He beat his abusive father to death. He discovered Parovich’s Black Hand ties and led his siblings into hiding; two are already dead. He met his sire’s fall without joy: too much in the story doesn’t add up. Jason owes him a favour; so did the late Scott.

raul.name: Raul
raul.html: A former grey-market car dealer, Blood Bound. He had long wondered why he hadn’t seen the others in six months; now his master is destroyed, the mansion boarded up, and the bond keeps dragging him to where his master isn’t.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: Some nights the bond pulls him downward, toward the drains. He hasn’t followed it yet.

badr.name: Badr-al-Budur
badr.html: She wants payment in the blood of Kindred of 9th generation or older. If she fails, no Assamite will ever take that target again, and she remembers everything about her employers.

raoul.name: Raoul
raoul.html: A former karate champion fed by Gracis. He and his heavily armed team stop Anarch raids just past the lobby.

vrasks.name: Vrasks
vrasks.html: Kills for Vampiric blood and buys it from broke Anarchs. Where he came from is a mystery.

venturi.name: Mr. Venturi
venturi.html: A 1920s Mafia tough grown bored of eternity. If a Mask member saved him from a burning car, he turned on the Prince at the end.

demetri.name: Demetri
demetri.html: An old ally of the Prince, long mad and fully Dominated. He hid the ghoul ambush in the penthouse with Obfuscate. Whether he survived Merik is the Storyteller’s call.

wilks.name: Lt. James Wilks
wilks.html: A mix of Columbo and Dirty Harry with a very high Willpower. Rescued from Merik’s dungeon, he promised silence and may come to the Mask for help on hard cases. He could turn a dangerous wing of the police against the Kindred if provoked.

urgen.name: Lisa Urgen
urgen.html: German, widowed and childless since a starving Vampire came to her house in the post-war ruins. She has hunted Kindred across two continents. A Neutral: Dominate and Presence simply do not work on her.

horatio.name: Horatio Sims
horatio.html: A lupus Red Talon who takes human shape only to negotiate: short, square-jawed, and the most rational of the Lupine leaders, which makes him the most dangerous. People gave him his name; he wears it like a muzzle. He freed the Mask because a broken Masquerade would expose the Garou next.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To hold Marquette long enough to dig, to burn the Banes out of the southern woods, and to do it all without starting a war he cannot win.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He has begun to suspect the totems cannot be taken back by one clan alone, and that the Eagle are the only partner he has. He despises the human city, but the Mouse pack’s fate showed him the Wyrm came in through the city, and that frightens him.

drake.name: Drake
drake.sub: Former Mouse go-between, now a servant of the Wyrm
drake.html: Usually a large wolf; otherwise a chubby, bald, middle-aged man. He carried messages between Merik’s killers and his pack leader. During the Sabbat invasion he was broken and given to the Wyrm; he got inside the Chapel and killed Victor, then vanished. They say he hides in the tunnels under the city.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: The corruption wasn’t forced on him: Jesselin whispered to him through his dreams for weeks, and he opened the Granary’s doors to her himself. He hides in the storm sewers under the concrete Kinnickinnic, and he is not alone down there.

marta.name: Marta Kaczmarek
marta.html: She does alterations and cooks community suppers. Her Glamour comes from people making something useful together and recognising each other’s skill. She survived 1981 because she went back for a mortal kitchen helper. She remembers the court kindly until anyone proposes restoring its privileges.

facts.v: Late fifties, compact, flour on her sleeves, a laugh that interrupts her own complaints.
Skin warm brown like baked crust, copper-bright eyes, curls escaping every pin.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: Enough rent money and helpers to keep the storefront through winter.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: The balefire falters when she tries to do everything herself, and she is hiding how weak it is. Her old guilt: she wants rest more than another heroic responsibility.
“You may be right. You still have to dry the dishes.”

leon.name: Leon Mercer
leon.sub: Builder of things that might work
leon.html: He repairs audio gear and industrial controls; his Chrysalis came in 1988 while getting a “useless” machine to run. He wants a short, reliable stretch of the old chimerical street railway, so that a childling never has to beg an elder for permission to visit a friend.

facts.v: Late twenties, thin, bespectacled, work shirt, a plastic box of mismatched parts.
Porcelain face patterned with soot-black whorls, tiny sparking eyes, copper-stained fingers.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: A stable test route, Oren’s permission to end it at the Counterweight, and a patron who won’t claim the finished line.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: The prototype works because it holds a shard of the Glass of the Second Door. The bell rings for passengers he can’t see. He has stopped carrying passengers but won’t give up the machine before he understands it.
“No, it isn’t temperamental. It is doing exactly the wrong thing every time.”

ruth.name: Ruth Bell
ruth.kicker: Eshu · grump · Seelie when promises are involved
ruth.sub: The woman who gets you there
ruth.html: Courier and driving work. Her Glamour comes from helping people make journeys that matter to them: an audition, a reunion, a first trip alone. She knows most local routes, but she cannot simply be wherever the plot requires.

facts.v: Around fifty, charcoal coat, worn road atlas, pocketful of bus transfers.
Midnight skin faintly dotted with stars, boots dusted with road that never wears off, a scarf moving in wind nobody else feels.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To reopen one trustworthy outward trod.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: In 1981 she cut the Copper Hart’s return route to stop a false-door incursion. There were voices beyond it, and she has never told Marta.
“Getting out is a direction. Where are you going?”

oren.name: Oren Voss
oren.html: He was the Copper Hart’s dependable defender, never its commander, and held the retreat in 1981 long enough for Ruth and Marta to get out. His Glamour comes from people keeping hard commitments, especially with nobody watching.

facts.v: Broad, middle-aged maintenance man, stiff knee, quiet voice, an immaculate thermos.
Blue-grey skin, horn tips worn smooth, old bronze plates beneath a wool coat.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To repair the dream-bridge’s counterweight before the autumn storms close the route.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: His oath is to give a return passage to anyone he personally admits. He has stretched it into a duty to save all Milwaukee, which is his own reading, and it makes him slow to welcome strangers.
When he says “I cannot promise that,” he means it as respect.

celia.name: Celia Ashdown
celia.html: She arrived in 1989 with a credible but practically unenforceable claim to properties once attached to the Copper Hart, and found people exhausted by titles. Her Glamour comes from ensembles learning to listen to one another.

facts.v: Late twenties, red-haired, teaches beginner cello, patches her own secondhand coats.
Spring-green eyes, a narrow golden circlet she seldom wears, an elegance that makes cheap rooms look briefly intentional.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To relight one chamber in the Crownless Ward as a public rehearsal and meeting hall.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: Her outside sponsor will fund her only for a list of local residents and their sworn obligations. She keeps not sending it.
“Yes, I know the proper ceremony. We could also start by repairing the roof.”

relations.title: Connections
rows: Suspects her; arranges songs with her

kit.name: Kit Navarro
kit.sub: Collector of things nearly thrown away
kit.html: Chrysalis in 1990. Kit collects futures people drop casually, and gains Glamour when someone unexpectedly uses one again.

facts.v: Seventeen, bicycle courier, patched jacket, an inexhaustible supply of useless keys.
Ringed tail, dark mask, bright ears, hands that cannot leave a strange fastening alone.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To get a bag of mislaid objects back from the Index before it is classified as a permanent acquisition. It holds a living chimerical mouse Kit promised to return to a child.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: Kit’s claim ticket names them custodian of a blue-lit room, not owner, and they have been pretending not to know the difference.
A bad lie is often a plea to be asked a kinder question.

nina.name: Nina Salazar
nina.sub: Insists there will be another song
nina.html: Chrysalis in 1987, at a disastrous show the audience saved by joining in. Her Glamour comes from a crowd that stops being an audience and becomes collaborators. She believes the survivors sometimes mistake safety for giving up.

facts.v: Mid-twenties Mexican American percussionist and part-time waitress; strong forearms, battered boots.
Dark curling horns, amber eyes, shaggy legs, the smell of warm wood after rain.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: A public neighbourhood performance before winter.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: The Encore answers to her music and will not let a good night end. She has cancelled two rehearsals trying to understand it.
“Let her be bad at it. She only started yesterday.”

relations.title: Connections
rows: Respects her; wary of rescue stories

bjorn.name: Bjorn Halvorsen
bjorn.html: He arrived after the war. His private vocation is tasting dreams: a brass apple from a schoolboy’s invented planet, a banquet nobody attends. Eating something in a dream may change that dream, but it doesn’t erase its real counterpart or cure the dreamer. He asks consent for repeat visits.

facts.v: Heavily muscled Scandinavian in a fisherman’s sweater.
Slate-red skin, ice-pale eyes, teeth like broken white crockery, impossible crumbs in his beard.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To taste the last fruit of the Winter Orchard.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He once bit through a bell in the mountain’s vestibule and now hears a faint note when someone promises what they have no right to give. It is imperfect, not infallible. The mountain wants its bell back.
“No. A nightmare can be excellent. That one was merely cruel.”

ivory.name: Ivory
ivory.sub: Custodian of the Gloaming Keep; overseer of the Michigan Pocket
ivory.html: To everyone at school she is just a grumpy high-school girl; she uses school and its Banality to stay steady while disliking it. Her Chrysalis came in 1986. Exploring the Pabst remains in the Dreaming, she found the eight survivors and joined the Hall’s fragments to the unclaimed sluagh holdings to make the Keep. She is also the sole remaining faerie overseer of the Michigan Pocket, the impossible cave under the lake where the local sluagh stole condemned buildings and crumbling architecture. It was a cultural site shared with the local Nosferatu until Parovich went Sabbat. She trains young mortal hunters with controlled chimerical exercises, and recently punished the Tremere alchemist Annalena for her unsanctioned expedition into the Keep.

facts.v: A grumpy schoolgirl.
The only sluagh left in Milwaukee; she remembers being a sidhe patron of heroes.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: Time, supplies and quiet.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She knows the Secret. She shelters eight changelings in Bedlam hoping to heal them, and will not regard death and reincarnation as an acceptable treatment. Annalena got into the Keep uninvited and lost several ghouls there; during her flight, fae retribution fell on the 7-Eleven where she stopped. The store is gone as if it never existed, the Mists made people forget it, and only a few feel that something is missing from that corner. Ivory also quietly helps a group of mortal vampire hunters, because one of them carries old fae blood.
Arrives late to supper, complains about nearly everything, helps without mentioning it, and leaves before gratitude becomes a ceremony.

lola.name: Dolores “Lola” Wendt
lola.html: A retired printing worker who keeps playbills, newsletters and the small publications nobody else saves. She knows some visitors see an extra Milwaukee and expects consent before anything leaves its community.

arthur.name: Arthur Saye
arthur.html: He has walked the Glass Orchard under temporary enchantment. He is weighing a better-paid job out of town, and the fae should support his real choice, not sabotage it to keep their Glamour.

hester.name: Hester Ames
hester.html: An observant, stubborn mature student who doesn’t know her distant sponsor is a vampire. She is interested in recurring dream geography. Her latest question was about a building that appears on no map but matches the Crownless Ward, and Mortius heard about it.

eddie.name: Eddie Rusk
eddie.html: Ivory has quietly encouraged his better instincts. He has learned to verify an exit and calm a panicking friend, and now mistakes that for understanding every monster.

quire.name: Mrs. Quire
quire.html: She wants every unfinished work to get a fair chance to finish. She can find a deposited manuscript by the question that created it, but can’t tell honest postponement from cowardice without talking to the person. Her excessive care is turning her into an antagonist. To release a dreamer, show her a life can stay worthwhile without finishing that work.

rent.name: The Rent Collector
rent.html: It wants rooms inhabited responsibly and can identify a valid custodial obligation on any door. It cannot create ownership or a deed. It accepts repairs, regular use or an orderly handover as payment, and turns threatening when someone hoards doors to keep others out.

usher.name: The Ashen Usher
usher.sub: Attendant of the Far Guest’s Seat
usher.html: It wants to discharge its duties without admitting nobody receives them. It opens the public chambers and interprets the audience customs, but cannot summon the dragon or leave while a petition is pending. A cassette case interests it more than a sword. The useful bargain is an honest new purpose that can actually be completed.

tollman.name: The Tollman of Two Banks
tollman.html: It wants recognition from both shores, and can delay a crossing, demand a hearing and remember bargains. Paying twice satisfies neither half. Introducing two people who really want to meet across the river can quiet it for weeks. Ruth thinks it is lonely; Oren thinks loneliness can still be extortion.

tuesday.name: Miss Tuesday
tuesday.html: Dreamed into coherence by workers looking forward to the small part of the week when they might finish something of their own. She follows the trail of any object genuinely missed by its maker. Her lunchbox holds the last compliment she received, written on a napkin.

encore.name: The Encore
encore.html: It wants an exceptional night never to end, and makes an enchanted audience feel that leaving would destroy something precious. It yields to a satisfying ending freely accepted. A curtain call dedicated to someone else’s next attempt can turn it into a useful stage-spirit, and Nina has to take part in that choice.

surveyor.name: The Surveyor of Necessary Losses
surveyor.html: It wants to prove every settlement requires someone else’s permanent loss. It consolidates structures by consuming others and honours narrow terms faithfully. It cannot seize a responsibly occupied room, and a cooperative repair that proves destruction isn’t the only affordable option defeats it. It was born from ordinary civic rationalisations.

alisande.name: Lady Alisande of the Copper Hart
alisande.sub: Former lady of the last court
alisande.html: She hosted the seasonal assemblies of 1969–79. Her court had beauty and useful hospitality, and a habit of treating other people’s labour as inexhaustible. She concentrated refugees at the Copper Hart in 1981, which seemed defensible and gave the attackers a predictable target. In the wards she keeps rehearsing an audience at which nobody has yet been hurt.

coil.name: Peter Coil
coil.html: He repairs a door that breaks whenever it opens.

june.name: June-of-the-Many-Ribbons
june.html: She experiences every visitor as someone still expected at a long-cancelled celebration. Marta made her a ribbon before the war.

silas.name: Silas Vane & Ada Vale
silas.html: Two particular predators with a particular scheme, not representatives of their clan. With the stolen Glass of the Second Door they turned familiar escape routes into prepared ambushes. Silas died with the sunrise on the mortal side of a compromised refuge. Ada was later hunted down by the surviving defenders. No Ravnos remain in Milwaukee.

vollmer.name: Anacreon Konrad Vollmer
vollmer.html: A brewery-ward alderman who died of old age in 1899 and has administered the dead ever since. He is precise, tired and proud of a city that rarely notices him. Milwaukee is a minor Citadel under the Chicago Necropolis, and Vollmer has spent ninety years keeping it too dull for Chicago to interfere.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: Merik’s victims Reaped, registered and quiet before Chicago sends an inspector.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He has a long, cordial acquaintance with the Malkavian Jason, whose Auspex can hear him. Some of Jason’s famously wise remarks in Council were Vollmer’s. Neither has told anyone.

reinholt.name: Sergeant Otto Reinholt
reinholt.sub: Marshal of the Soldiers Home garrison
reinholt.html: A Civil War veteran knifed in a tavern quarrel outside the Soldiers Home in 1898. He commands the garrison and the Ninth Watch, and believes in drill, rosters and the dignity of soldiers who are forgotten.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To find and Reap whoever is turning Juneau Park into a killing ground. He does not yet know the killer is already destroyed.

dolan.name: Centurion Thomas Dolan
dolan.html: A Third Ward militiaman drowned with the Lady Elgin in 1860, who took her helm on this side because nobody else would. He is cheerful, superstitious and very good on bad water.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: A new crew. Too many of his drowned have forgotten their names.

anselm.name: Father Anselm
anselm.html: A parish priest who died in the influenza of 1918. He keeps the Citadel’s book of the dead and pares back Shadows with Castigation, gently and without illusions. This autumn he has to enter strangers too: the homeless that Dragos Dalca took for his fleshcraft keep turning up as new, bewildered ghosts by the harbour and the fish plant.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He has been writing some of the newly dead into the book as “passed beyond” and letting them go to Walnut Street.

grau.name: Matron Ilse Grau
grau.html: A county poor-farm matron who died at her post in 1911. She knows the name of every unmarked grave and is watching the excavation unpick her charges one coffin at a time.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: A week’s delay, a list of names returned to the living, and the Anacreon’s permission for either.

penny.name: Mr. Penny
penny.html: Edwin Pennington, a hotel accountant who died at his desk in 1931, still balances the ledgers of the dead. Everything has a price. He is honest about it, which most people find worse.

brauer.name: Hilde Brauer
brauer.html: A tannery forewoman killed by a boiler in 1902. She forges the chains and coin the Citadel runs on. She is brilliant, pragmatic and very short of materials.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She wants Merik’s victims for the forge. The Anacreon has not said no.

duval.name: Colette Duval
duval.sub: Mistress of the Pabst Theater gallery
duval.html: A touring actress who died onstage in 1924. She is the Citadel’s face for delicate errands and its best liar.

hollis.name: Lorraine Hollis
hollis.html: A jazz singer who died in 1959, a few years before the bulldozers came. She holds relic Bronzeville together with music, memory and a hard-won rule that nobody is Reaped on her street. She has heard of the sluagh child, Ivory, and would like to meet her.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To bring Merik’s newly dead to Walnut Street before anyone forges them into coin.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: Her neighbourhood exists because people remember it. In 1991 fewer living people do every year, and the edges are starting to fray.

mazur.name: Joe Mazur
mazur.html: He says he was a rolling-mill hand shot in the Bay View volley of 1886. His name is not on any list of the dead, and he says the list is wrong. He is fierce, funny, and allergic to anyone who wears a Legion mask.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: Merik’s newly dead, before the Hierarchy chains them.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: His Shadow has more say in the Circle’s plans than he realises.

clotilde.name: Sister Clotilde
clotilde.html: A teaching nun who died in 1949 and was led to the chapel by its cold stone. She is luminous and certain, and kind to strangers.

benchcouple.name: The bench couple
benchcouple.html: Two ordinary people walking home from a movie. They are Enfants, days dead, Fettered to a park bench and to each other, and everyone in the Shadowlands wants them for something.

burningman.name: The Burning Man
burningman.sub: The fire in the Newhall ruin
burningman.html: Whatever keeps the Newhall House burning. It wears the faces of the 1883 dead and offers to end their suffering.

drainthing.name: The Drain-Thing
drainthing.html: Once a wraith, long since eaten by its own Shadow. It has learned that vampires are lonely in a way it can taste. It talks to Milo because nobody listens to Milo.

tworuiz.name: Two-Moons Ruiz
tworuiz.html: A quiet grey she-wolf Theurge. The quarry workers who saw her on the rim of the pit named her “Ruiz”, and she tolerates the name with distaste. She almost never takes human shape: the human city disgusts her, but she knows its spirits better than anyone in the clan. She keeps a standing table at the Copper Queen’s court and an informant among the Storm-Crows.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: An honest answer from the Drowned Thief.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She has already spoken to Usla once, and has not told Horatio what he said.

patience.name: Patience Vey
patience.sub: Keeper of the Grudge-Song (the Coyote version)
patience.html: The Coyote’s memory. A rust-coloured she-wolf who knows the clan’s history back to Usla as a long comic epic that changes a little every time she tells it, and there isn’t a single human word in it: only howls, growls and laughter. She swears oaths under the Polish Moon because she trusts nothing else, and travels to the clock over rooftops so as not to touch the asphalt.

oldquarry.name: Old Quarry
oldquarry.html: A grey wolf who has never worn a human face for more than an hour. He judges disputes for the clan by staring at both parties until one of them laughs. He remembers the last time the Coyote and the Eagle almost made peace.

lark.name: Lark
lark.sub: A young she-wolf who wants the feud to end
lark.html: First Changed a year ago; in human shape she looks like an awkward girl of sixteen, and she hates it. She has been secretly meeting Tamsin Rook of the Eagle on the Treaty Green, and they are close to doing something brave and stupid. Since they fought Banes side by side in the blighted woods, they are harder to separate.

agnes.name: Agnes Hightree, Sky-Rends
agnes.html: A big, grey-haired woman, a farmer by day and leader of the raids by night. Her family has lived on this land longer than the city has existed, and she knows every elder in Milwaukee’s Native communities. Through trusted people the pack secretly owns the Seven Fires casino; Agnes never sets foot in its halls, but its money pays for lawyers, buys land and puts children through school. She hates the Kindred with a pure, practised hatred, and the Coyote only slightly less. She is not stupid. She knows the raids will kill her people one day, and now that the Tremere have poisoned her forest, she cannot see how to save even that.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To clear the Banes from her woods, and proof that the Coyote stole the Talon, or that they didn’t.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She has felt Gnaw riding her raiders and thinks it is the Eagle’s anger. It isn’t.

coaleye.name: Coal-Eye
coaleye.html: A lean metis with one black eye and one burned one. He has scouted every Kindred haven on the east side through the Umbra’s taint, and he can draw you a map. This autumn he is drawing a different map, of the Bane nests in his own forest, and it grows faster than he can draw.

sparrow.name: Brother Sparrow
sparrow.html: A gentle former seminarian who could never choose between his grandfather’s prayers and the mission’s, and finally kept both. He hears the Wounded Eagle’s voice in the wind. Lately it has been telling him to hate harder.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: What he hears is Gnaw. Parovich fed it first; now the remnants of Velez’s Sabbat do.

tamsin.name: Tamsin Rook
tamsin.kicker: Garou · Eagle · Child of Gaia Galliard
tamsin.html: Seventeen and fierce. The only member of the clan who isn’t Wendigo: a Child of Gaia whom Agnes took in when her own pack died. She sings the Grudge better than anyone in the clan and has started, privately, to doubt it. She is meeting Lark of the Coyote.

rosa.name: Rosa “Granary” Wójcik
rosa.sub: Former leader of the Mouse clan
rosa.html: Fifty, a produce wholesaler’s widow with a voice that carried across a warehouse floor. She held fifteen difficult Garou together by feeding them, scolding them and never forgetting a favour, and kept the moon bridge to the Coyote open because she believed the clans would need each other. She died in the Granary’s cellars on the night the Sabbat and the Tremere came, last, at the door the others would have escaped through.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To learn why part of her pack helped Merik, and who ordered it. Now she never will.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She suspected Erica was dead but not how. A week before she died she smelled strange blood in the Warrens and put it down to Merik’s Kindred.

benny.name: Benny Two-Shoes
benny.kicker: Garou · Mouse · Glass Walker Ragabash · fallen
benny.sub: Union man (the other kind), now missing
benny.html: A dockworkers’ union steward and full-time trickster who knew every cellar, loading dock and back door in the Third Ward. He thought the Kindred were hilarious and dangerous, in that order. The Sabbat got to him through debts and anger; on the night of the massacre he was seen in the cellars on the wrong side. Nobody has seen him since, and the Bazaar’s traders say his tracks smell of the Wyrm.

teodor.name: Little Teodor
teodor.html: Born of two Mouse Garou, small, misshapen and very clever. He kept the doors of the Warrens and decided who counted as “large”. On the night of the massacre he decided wrong: Jesselin came small.

mira.name: Mira Kessler
mira.html: A former boxer who ran beside Erica the Gangrel for ten years and loved her like a sister. She died covering the pack’s retreat and took two shovelheads with her.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She tracked Erica’s scent to Merik’s penthouse the night she died and knew the Prince had killed her. She told no one, and the secret died with her.

wojciks.name: The Wójcik family
wojciks.html: Three generations of Rosa’s in-laws. They fed the pack, hid its wounded and were fiercely uncurious. Now they have buried Rosa, and they ask no questions of Mercer, who comes to Sunday dinner.

dot.name: Dot Brennan
dot.html: Practical, funny and tired: the Eagle clan’s quartermaster and conscience, who has buried two sons who Changed. This autumn her cattle are sick and so is the creek, and she was the first to understand the forest had been poisoned.

abe.name: Abe Lindqvist
abe.html: An ordinary man who knows nothing: he keeps the mortal world away from the Grinning Stone with fences, paperwork and a shotgun he has never fired. The Coyote’s wolves tolerate him, the only human they tolerate, because he keeps other humans away, and because an old wolf line smoulders in his blood through a Swedish great-grandmother. Abe thinks the wolves on the rim of the pit are just very bold coyotes.

grin.name: Coyote’s Grin
grin.sub: The Coyote’s patron, one eye blind
grin.html: Cunning, generous and cruel by turns. It wants its eye back, and it will happily trick its own children into getting it.

woundedeagle.name: The Wounded Eagle
woundedeagle.sub: The Eagle’s patron, one talon gone
woundedeagle.html: Proud and furious, crying for its talon. It has never forgiven, and it does not understand why its children are dying.

grandmouse.name: Grandmother Mouse
grandmouse.html: Tiny, silver and ancient, the survivor of everything. She taught her children to hide, to share and to bite only when it mattered. Now she has one child left, and she is silent; Mercer can’t tell whether she is sleeping or dying.

drownedthief.name: The Drowned Thief
drownedthief.html: An outcast Garou who stole two totems’ strength to save the Menominee from Chiclena’s brood, and then hid his theft in his own body. Greatwater keeps him. He is the only witness to the truth of the theft, and to the rite that sealed Holy Hill.

greatwater.name: Greatwater
greatwater.html: Vast, cold and indifferent. It speaks through fog, ice and storm, and it has never taken a side.

breeze.name: The Lake Breeze
breeze.sub: Witness of the Lake Park Truce
breeze.html: Brisk, cheerful and smug. It cools tempers and carries the news of any broken truce to every caern in the city.

ravinekids.name: The Ravine Children
ravinekids.html: Small, giggling and rule-breaking. They will lead you anywhere for a game.

unnamed.name: The Unnamed
unnamed.sub: The thing at the bottom of the bog
unnamed.html: It changes those who listen to it.

icemother.name: Ice-Mother’s Remnant
icemother.sub: The ice that carved the lake
icemother.html: Mostly asleep. She stirs in hard winters, and then the Ice Road on the death side freezes in sympathy.

lapham.name: Lapham’s Watcher
lapham.html: Meticulous and kind. It will warn the clans of storms if asked politely and thanked afterwards.

alewives.name: The Thousand Alewives
alewives.html: Silver, mournful and vengeful. It remembers every poison poured into the lake and who poured it.

kinnickinnic.name: Kinnickinnic
kinnickinnic.html: It begs every passing Garou to break one band. Each band broken floods a few blocks of the South Side’s Penumbra.

northdam.name: The Dammed Reach
northdam.sub: The Milwaukee River behind the dam
northdam.html: It remembers everything said over its water and waits for the dam to come down.

eightcount.name: Eight-Count
eightcount.html: A crystalline spider the size of a bus that counts everything. It cannot imagine a thing it hasn’t counted, and it is beginning to notice the uncounted gap where the Pabst Building used to be.

tallest.name: The Tallest Thing
tallest.html: A proud civil servant of a spirit that sees the whole Penumbra from its roof and trades what it sees for new compliments.

warden.name: The Concrete Warden
warden.html: Square and tireless. It believes it saves lives, and it may be right.

spindle.name: The Departure Spindle
spindle.html: It keeps the manifest of everything that leaves, and it cannot imagine why anyone would stay.

mowers.name: The Mowing Spiders
mowers.html: Pale and flat, and harmless unless you are a weed.

inkwell.name: The Inkwell
inkwell.html: Many-handed and always on deadline. It trades rumours with every spirit in town.

bridgenowhere.name: The Bridge to Nowhere
bridgenowhere.html: Shy and enormous. It carries anyone who tells it where they are going.

parkeast.name: The Park East Spur
parkeast.html: It expects to be torn down and spends its nights apologising to the neighbourhood beneath it.

gambrinus.name: Gambrinus
gambrinus.sub: Old king of the Pabst hill
gambrinus.html: Generous, sentimental and frightened of the end. His vats are running low.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: A reason to believe he will last.

copperqueen.name: The Copper Queen
copperqueen.sub: Spirit of the State Street brewery
copperqueen.html: Bright, rich and expanding. Her peace is the strongest neutral law in the Penumbra, and she collects everyone’s stories.

widow.name: The Widow of the Vats
widow.html: She polishes kettles nobody will fill and gives old recipes to anyone who promises to brew them.

ironhorse.name: The Iron Horse
ironhorse.html: Loud, proud and fast. It loved the wolf who rode with the Blood Brothers, and now that wolf has vanished and the Horse searches the whole city for him.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: It meant to offer Akawa a pact that would have made him, in spirit terms, a lesser totem of the Blood Brothers. Now it can smell Akawa’s trail, faint, reeking of old blood and stone, and it will serve anyone who leads it to its rider. Whoever helps will learn where the Council keeps its prisoner.

compost.name: Grandmother Compost
compost.html: Immense and unhurried. The Wyrm, the Weaver and the Wyld all respect her, and she has outlived three septs.

reassembled.name: The Reassembled
reassembled.sub: Spirit of the South Side basilica
reassembled.html: A patchwork giant built from another city’s stones. It shelters spirits who have lost their homes.

ambassador.name: The Grey Ambassador
ambassador.html: Wise, sad and patient. Lupus Garou find it unbearable and come back anyway.

lantern.name: The Healers’ Lantern
lantern.html: It helps any Garou who comes to heal and no Garou who comes to fight.

hedgelords.name: The Hedgerow Lords
hedgelords.sub: Proud spirits of the North Shore
hedgelords.html: Trespass is the only crime they recognise. They have been known to hire Banes as watchmen.

moonkeeper.name: The Moonkeeper
moonkeeper.html: A tall Lune in silver, with a clock face for a mirror. She enforces every oath sworn beneath her moon and opens the Lunar Stair once a year.

tallow.name: Tallow
tallow.html: Slow, enormous and nearly unkillable while the valley feeds it.

tannintwins.name: The Tannin Twins
tannintwins.html: Joined at the hip. They cure anything thrown in until it can never rot or grow again.

static.name: Static
static.html: It feeds on panic and wrong addresses.

murmur.name: Murmur
murmur.html: A grey mist that feeds on every shout and every unanswered plea.

hive.name: The Hive-Queen
hive.html: Half Weaver, half something hungrier, and expanding into the woods.

gnaw.name: Gnaw
gnaw.html: Thin and grinning. It whispers to the Eagle’s Rage. Parovich used to feed it blood; now the leftovers of Guillem Velez’s Sabbat do, and in the blighted woods it finds plenty of its own food.

jade.name: Jade Riley
jade.html: Appointed over the heads of the local Brujah through the machinations of her grandsire, an old Methuselah who wants to steer the clan back to its philosopher-king roots. Jade is educated, sharp-tongued and terrifying in a fight: she killed Dragos Dalca with her hands at the fish plant. And still nobody takes her seriously. To the Elders she is an outsider and an upstart; to the Blood Brothers she is an outsider “sent from above”. She is not well liked, and she knows it.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To be reckoned with for what she has done, not for who sent her.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: Her grandsire doesn’t want victories from her. He wants lectures: he wants her to found a school in the city. Jade doesn’t want to be anyone’s project.

jade.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

macy.name: Macy Carver
macy.html: Pushing forty, looks twenty. A trust-fund kid and a rebel by vocation: marches against the Gulf War, squats, raves, eco-camps. Wherever someone is protesting something, she is there, and everything she learns she brings to Jade. The house the Brujah Primogen sleeps in is hers.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: For Jade to finally do something truly radical.

macy.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

jamie.name: Jamie Robinson
jamie.html: The voice of the Rust Saints and one of the most recognisable faces of the local punk scene. Jade Embraced him for his fury and his ability to hold a room. His family’s gas station on Highway 41 is gone: Ivory carried it off to the Michigan Pocket when the building was condemned. Jamie has been there. The pumps still work.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To get the station back, or at least to decide whether he wants it back.

jamie.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

kayla.name: Kayla
kayla.sub: Ghoul, sister of the Church of Isis
kayla.html: Calm, observant, never without a notebook. A member of the Church of Isis’s inner circle. She works for Jade and for Dr. Mortius at the same time, and each of them believes she is his or her person first.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She tells each of them different things and writes the truth down only for the Church.

kayla.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

arianna.name: Arianna
arianna.sub: Ghoul, student, sister of the Church of Isis
arianna.html: An Egyptology student trusted with too much, too soon. Sometimes she deals with the Chapel directly, without the Church’s go-betweens: she carries books, blood and messages. Haberman finds her “charmingly useful”.
arianna.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

annalena.name: Annalena
annalena.html: Before her Embrace she was a mage of House Tremere, back when it was an order of wizards and not a clan. She remembers the taste of real magic and looks for it in her flasks. She recently led an unsanctioned expedition into the Gloaming Keep, lost several valuable ghouls there and earned Ivory’s anger. Her flight ended at a convenience store that no longer exists. She is on thin ice with the Chapel’s council and with the fae alike.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To prove the expedition was worth it.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She brought something out of the Keep. Ivory knows exactly what.

annalena.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

haberman.name: Benjamin Haberman
haberman.html: Long hair, half-moon spectacles, rings in one ear, a pinstriped waistcoat and the smile of a man who knows where the right book is. Embraced in Vienna in the 1890s, he has spent the century on what he loves most: blood genealogy, the bibliography of the forbidden, and gossip. Without Vienna watching he has blossomed: he orders books he would once have had to hide and corresponds with half the occult booksellers of the Midwest. He is writing a history of the null zone and is sure he will be the first to understand what lies under the chapel.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: Access to St. Joan of Arc Chapel before the ritual begins.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: One of his society correspondents is Jesselin. He suspects her and thinks he is playing her. She thinks the same.

haberman.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

newman.name: Luke Newman
newman.sub: Chapel researcher, acting head of security
newman.html: Bald, chalk-pale, with pointed ears and thick round spectacles: the mark of an old ritual gone wrong that he does not discuss. A researcher of wards and boundaries, a pedant, a man of lists. After Victor’s death he was made acting head of security because he knows best how wards break. He rebuilt the Chapel’s defences in three nights, started a visitors’ log and vets even the Church of Isis ghouls. He also built the antenna rigs for the four anchors.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To find who weakened the wards from inside.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He already knows the leak ran through Haberman’s correspondence. He is keeping quiet to catch whoever is on the other end.

newman.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

maximus.name: Maximus McKenzie
maximus.sub: Sabbat sorcerer, dealer in blood-magic totems
maximus.html: A charming Scot with tattooed forearms. He sold the local Caitiff and Anarchs blood-magic totems: cheap, effective and dangerous. He helped the Sabbat infiltration and, with Jesselin, defiled the protected places in the woods so that a Bane infestation would distract the Garou. He vanished when the invasion failed.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He never left the city. His cache is in a sewer under Bay View, and every totem he sold is his ear and his eye.

maximus.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

jesselin.name: Jesselin
jesselin.sub: Goratrix agent: scrying and social infiltration
jesselin.html: As “Miss Lascelles”, a patroness of charity balls and opera boxes. In truth a sorceress of House Goratrix who scries the Chapel and tries to learn what it is hiding. With Maximus she corrupted the Mouse pack and poisoned the forest’s places of power. The Chapel doesn’t know she exists.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To learn what the Chapel has found under the null zone, and take it.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She gave Drake the way through the Chapel’s wards. Victor’s death is her work.

jesselin.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

ethan.name: Ethan Stone
ethan.sub: Blood Brother, archer and urban-combat specialist
ethan.html: Quiet, lean, calloused from the bowstring. A specialist in rooftop and alley fighting and a remarkably gifted archer: a wooden shaft through the heart at forty metres is his signature. He did business with Maximus, buying “charmed” arrowheads. Since Akawa’s capture he and Wrecker have kept the Brothers from splitting.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He still has one of Maximus’s totems, and he hasn’t thrown it away.

ethan.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

dominique.name: Dominique
dominique.sub: Blood Brothers ganger, candidate for the Embrace
dominique.html: An ordinary kid from the block who ran errands for the Brothers. When a Camarilla vampire showed up at his flat, Dominique burned him down with a lighter and a can of air freshener. He was ghouled and seriously discussed for the Embrace, but the political turmoil and Akawa’s capture put everything on hold. He doesn’t like waiting.
dominique.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

dragos.name: Dragos Dalca
dragos.sub: Sabbat elder, maker of the invasion army
dragos.html: An old Carpathian master of flesh. He harvested material from the homeless and the fish plants and built an enormous army of sculpted abominations. He was caught on camera in dragon form chasing a Camarilla team from a derelict warehouse district on the city’s edge. Jade Riley killed him in an all-out brawl by the fish plant, causing a second huge Masquerade breach. Most of his creatures died in the fighting, but nests and loners live on, especially underground.
dragos.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

guillem.name: Guillem Velez
guillem.sub: Operational commander of the Sabbat in Milwaukee
guillem.html: A Catalan with perfect manners and a soldier’s bearing. He kept contact with the local collaborators (Parovich, Maximus, some Anarchs) and recruited the shovelheads. When the infiltration failed he went into the shadows, in both senses, with a handful of loyalists. The Camarilla has put a price on him.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To hold out until reinforcements come from Detroit, or at least to take someone important with him.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He keeps feeding the Bane Gnaw with blood so that the Eagle keep raiding and the Garou and Camarilla never make peace. He also knows where the vozhd is.

guillem.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

castor.name: Castor
castor.sub: Dragos’s apprentice, keeper of the surviving creatures
castor.html: Dragos’s childe and journeyman. Graceful, boneless, forever changing his face. He hides in the flesh tunnels under the Menomonee Valley and feeds the surviving creatures. He thinks of them as his children.

noemi.name: Noemí Santana
noemi.sub: Ductus of the Black Water pack
noemi.html: Leader of the last true Sabbat pack in the city: three vampires and a couple of surviving shovelheads. Angry, funny, hungry. She guards Velez, though she doesn’t like him.

hieronymus.name: Hieronymus
hieronymus.sub: Priest of the Black Water pack
hieronymus.html: Performs the Vaulderie in a flooded cistern and preaches to the rats. He hears the vozhd through the stone and calls it “the Choir”.

gunther.name: Gunther
gunther.html: Red-bearded, with braids at his temples and a pipe that never leaves his hand; his leather coat smells of smoke and lake. He came to the city in the 1840s and served Merik as a kind of gamekeeper, the man for errands beyond the city line. He was a friend of Erica, the Prince’s wife, and through her of the Mouse pack. He is the last Kindred the Mouse ever trusted, and he still keeps in touch with Mercer.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To learn how Erica really died.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He suspects Merik and is afraid of the thought: if it’s true, he served her killer for half a century.

gunther.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

soraya.name: Soraya
soraya.sub: Recluse of the house that isn’t there
soraya.html: Tall, with all-black eyes and a voice like turning pages. She keeps out of politics and rarely leaves her hidden mansion, where she cares for her sire, who went mad after researching Dementation. She sometimes receives guests (those who manage to find the door) and pays for books with knowledge.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: A way to give her sire back his mind.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: In his ravings her sire sometimes speaks in the voice of the null zone.

soraya.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

vane.name: Lucretian Vane
vane.html: A scholar who tried to dissect the Malkavian madness as a science, and lost. He wanders the mansion’s rooms, rearranging mirrors and talking to people who aren’t there.

wolfgang.name: Wolfgang
wolfgang.html: A taciturn mechanic with oil to the elbows. He builds the group’s cars, traps and flamethrowers out of spare parts. He started hunting after a customer vanished from his garage.
wolfgang.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

rudeus.name: Rudeus Frost
rudeus.html: A huge, loud Scandinavian who laughs in a fight. There is faerie blood in his family, so he sees more than he should and isn’t afraid of what he ought to fear. He fights with a sword and thinks hunting is the best way to spend a night.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: Ivory sees kin in him and quietly helps the group: hints, luck, sometimes a dream on the right night.

rudeus.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

drfire.name: Doctor Fire
drfire.html: A professor of archaeology who found more in old expedition notes than he was looking for and taught himself to conjure fire. The group’s brain. His fire magic is crude and dangerous, first of all to himself.
drfire.src: From the chronicle canon; details improvised.

agatha.name: Mother Agatha
agatha.sub: Matriarch of the Warrens, acting Nosferatu voice on the Council
agatha.html: Hunched, enormous, a shawl over her hump. She ruled the Warrens while Parovich sat on the Council, and rules them again since his fall. She is ashamed of his treachery and makes the whole Council remember it: the Nosferatu owe nobody anything now.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To restore the alliance with the Pocket’s changelings and root Dragos’s creatures out of the tunnels.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: She can smell something in the tunnels that reminds her of Parovich. For now she tells herself it is memory.

cricket.name: Cricket
cricket.html: Young, fidgety, with a face like a cricket’s. He taps phone lines and police frequencies and keeps a card file on everyone in the city. He sells what he knows at the Rat Market.

dust.name: Brother Dust
dust.html: Quiet, coated in stone dust. For decades he visited the Michigan Pocket as a guest of the sluagh and helped them “carry” buildings. Since Parovich went over to the Sabbat the door has been shut. Brother Dust keeps watch on this side and hopes Ivory will open it one day.

vozd.name: The vozhd in the tunnels
vozd.html: A vast mass of flesh that Dragos sculpted from ghouls, shovelheads and prisoners. There is a mind in it, and one of the faces in its flank belongs to Parovich. The former Nosferatu Primogen was not destroyed: he was melted into the vozhd as punishment and as a spare brain. He remembers everything and sometimes speaks through its mouths.

mercer.name: Mercer
mercer.sub: The last Garou of the Mouse clan
mercer.html: Around forty, wiry, bespectacled, a night technician at the telephone exchange. He ran phone lines into the Warrens while the others still used notes, and he survived only because on the night of the massacre he was up a pole on the far side of the city. He says little, makes dry jokes at the wrong moment and drinks coffee by the litre. Every night he goes down into the dying Granary, lights the candle-stubs and talks to Grandmother Mouse, who doesn’t answer. He doesn’t trust Kindred, with one exception.

notes.title: Wants now
notes.html: To cleanse the Granary, wake Grandmother Mouse, and find out where Jesselin and Maximus McKenzie are now.

notes.title: Pressure & secret · Storyteller
notes.html: He meets the Gangrel Gunther, Erica’s old friend, in secret: Gunther brings him news of the Kindred world, Mercer brings news of the Umbra. He also knows Drake is hiding in the tunnels under the city and has twice left food for him at an old manhole. He can’t bring himself to kill him, or to tell Horatio.

pg-invasion.title: The Sabbat invasion · autumn 1991

pg-strife.title: A city of strife
pg-strife.html: Some 30–40 Kindred hold a city of 628,000 under permanent Lupine siege. Few get in and none get out. Merik’s madness ended at the hands of the Mask, and every faction is now reaching for the throne.

pg-outside.title: Outside pressure
pg-outside.html: Prince Lodin of Chicago wants a harsher ally on the throne, and his lieutenants Ballard and Capone are already buying in. Nicolai of the Chicago Tremere sends spies. Sheboygan and Green Bay covet the city, and the Council of Madison would make it an Anarch stronghold. The Nosferatu clan is sending agents to watch Parovich.

pg-council.title: The Council of Elders
pg-council.html:
VentrueGracis NostinusPushes for a 7th (Ventrue) seat
ToreadorLucinaVotes with Gracis
TremereCarnaVotes with Gracis, quietly backs Hrothulf
NosferatuMother Agatha (acting)Parovich’s seat is empty; the Warrens speak through her
BrujahJade RileyAppointed through her Methuselah grandsire; nobody takes her seriously
MalkavianJasonSwing vote; watching Jade
Gangrel(seat abolished)Decker never attended
The seventh-seat vote stood at 3–3. Parovich wanted the seat to go to Hrothulf to shatter the Council and open the city to the Sabbat; the Sabbat came anyway and was beaten back. Now Mother Agatha sits for the Nosferatu and Jade Riley for the Brujah, and nobody knows how either will vote. These are Kindred dangers, not fae borders: a changeling can still ride a daytime bus out of town.

pg-domains-note.title: Personal domains
pg-domains-note.html: Each Kindred’s own patch: where they sleep, hunt and expect to be asked first. Without a Prince nobody can grant a domain, so every claim here is held by habit, nerve or a Council member’s indulgence. Vacant and contested domains belonged to the dead. Toggle the Kindred domains layer (or press D) to see them on the map.

pg-pins.title: Reading the pins
pg-pins.html: Reading the pins. Colour shows who holds the site. Solid ring: the source names the place. Dashed: the source gives the area and the spot was chosen. Dotted: the source is silent, so the site is placed by real Milwaukee geography and the lore. Shift-click a category to show only that one. Switch to Dreaming at the top of the map to see the other side.

pg-kindred-note.title: Elsewhere
pg-kindred-note.html: The city’s changelings are listed on the Dreaming side, its wraiths in the Shadowlands, the Garou clans with their Kinfolk and spirits in the Umbra, and the Nosferatu of the Warrens under Underground. A † marks the destroyed.

pg-dream-near.title: Near and Deep
pg-dream-near.html: Near and Deep. The Near Dreaming keeps enough earthly geography for rivers and neighbourhoods to matter. Deep shows the inner stacks, the Ward’s distant ruins and the mountain’s upper rooms. Dotted threads tie a dreaming place to its mortal anchor.

pg-census.title: The census
pg-census.html: The census. Nine active local Kithain, and eight hidden survivors in Bedlam that only Ivory knows about. Visiting fae are rare individuals, not a second court waiting offstage.

pg-court.title: A community without a court
pg-court.html:
There is no baron, seneschal or council. Marta can refuse hospitality at her own hearth and Oren can refuse to lower his own bridge, but neither can tax the city or order anyone into battle. Once a month, whoever is willing meets for the Spare Chair Supper, with an empty chair for anyone not yet found. Nobody takes minutes. Three customs have taken hold:

  1. Ask before bringing anyone onto a trod.
  2. Never draw cold iron inside an offered refuge.
  3. Leave a newly found changeling’s mortal family out of disputes.

These are fragile agreements, not law. Breaking them costs you guides, repairs, invitations and shelter.

pg-fae-history.title: The history people disagree about
pg-fae-history.html: The fae still make things: they mend coats, rehearse bad first plays, build radios and teach children songs. What they have lost is the confidence that these acts add up to a future. Their great buildings survive in the Dreaming. Their institutions mostly do not.

pg-fae-next.title: What happens next if nobody intervenes

pg-fae-three.title: The city’s three disagreements
pg-fae-three.html: Who keeps the fire? The Hearth serves people who stay; the Counterweight helps people move through. Who owns something abandoned? Old promises still govern towers, roads and treasures whose keepers are dead. How much should be remembered? The survivors disagree about the war, and the chimera remember it vividly and often wrongly.

pg-shadow-note.title: Everything on this side is improvised
pg-shadow-note.html: Everything on this side is improvised. Real fires, massacres and demolitions anchor the haunts, and those are tagged History. Every named wraith, hall and byway is invented. Pale outlines are relics: buildings the living city has lost that still stand beneath the Shroud. Tempest shows the Nihils, the Sea of Shadows and the deep byways.

pg-citadel.title: A small Citadel
pg-citadel.html: A small Citadel. Milwaukee answers to the Chicago Necropolis across the lake. Four Legions keep a presence here, the guilds keep their halls, and the free wraiths of Walnut Street keep their own counsel. All improvised.

pg-legions.title: The Legions in Milwaukee
pg-legions.html:
IronThe CitadelThose who died of old age. Anacreon Vollmer’s own.
GrimSoldiers HomeThose who died by violence. Sergeant Reinholt and the Ninth Watch.
EmeraldHarbor mouthThose who died by accident. Centurion Dolan and the Lady Elgin.
PenitentCounty GroundsThose who died in madness or despair. Matron Grau.

pg-shroud.title: The Shroud
pg-shroud.html: Pale mist marks where the wall between the living and the dead is thin: cemeteries, fire sites, the harbor, Walnut Street, anywhere recently drenched in death. Darkness marks where it is thick: the airport, the malls, glass-and-concrete federal buildings. Wraiths act more easily where it is thin.

pg-touch.title: Where the worlds touch
pg-touch.html: The Everett Street depot is the Hearse Train’s station on this side and the fae’s Waiting Platform in the Dreaming. The Pabst Building’s False Floor is a scar from the War of False Doorsis a mystery the wraiths avoid. Lorraine Hollis has heard of a sluagh child named Ivory, and the sluagh have always been able to hear the dead. Milo’s drain is not empty. Merik’s Gangrel wife Erica left no wraith: nothing of a destroyed vampire crosses.

pg-dead.title: The city’s dead
pg-dead.html: Milwaukee has buried its disasters well. On this side of the Shroud the ship still sails, the hotel still burns and the neighbourhood the freeway erased is still lit up on a Saturday night.

pg-dead-autumn.title: What the dead are doing this autumn
pg-dead-autumn.html: The real events (the Lady Elgin, the Newhall House fire, the Bay View massacre, the 1917 bombing, the clearing of Bronzeville, the 1991 poor-farm excavation) are history. Treat them with the weight they carry. Everything said about their dead here is invented.

pg-umbra-note.title: Everything on this side is improvised
pg-umbra-note.html: Everything on this side is improvised, built on the book’s Lupine material: Usla’s theft, the three clans and the relics buried under Marquette. Each coloured field is a spirit zone with its own law, and its number is the Gauntlet there. Dark smudges are Kindred havens as the spirits see them. Gateways shows the paths out to the Realms.

pg-clans-note.title: Three clans, one feud
pg-clans-note.html: Three clans, one feud. The book’s Lupines are the Coyote (all Red Talons), the Eagle (almost all Wendigo) and the Mouse (Glass Walkers, all but wiped out: only Mercer is left). Horatio Sims and Drake are the book’s; everyone else here is improvised. The Kindred most tangled with the spirit side are , whom the spirits take for a strange kind of Garou, and , who drinks Lupine blood.

pg-gauntlet.title: Reading the Gauntlet
pg-gauntlet.html: The number is the Gauntlet’s strength: the difficulty of stepping sideways. It runs from 1 in the Bog of First Waters, where the wall is nearly gone, to 8 in the Glass Thicket and the airport, where the Weaver has spun it thick. Over Marquette it swings between 2 and 9 from minute to minute. Every zone also has a law: a rule the local spirits enforce and that Gifts, rites and visitors must respect.

pg-spirit-history.title: The spirit-history of the city
pg-spirit-history.html: Milwaukee’s Umbra was shaped by one theft. When Usla stole half of two totems and buried them in himself, he set the Coyote and the Eagle against each other for three hundred years. Everything since, breweries, freeways, Merik’s schemes, has been built on top of that wound.

pg-spirit-autumn.title: What the spirits and the clans are doing this autumn

pg-clans.title: The three clans
pg-clans.html:
ClanCaernLeadsGarou
CoyoteGrinning Stone (quarries, NW)Horatio Sims~12
The strongest clan: lupus wolves who despise the human city; rational and cunning, they want the Eye back without a war. Now helping the Eagle clean the woods. Optional tribe reading: Red Talons.
EagleBleeding Pine (Root River, S)Agnes Hightree~8
Fewest and angriest; used to raid weekly; blame the Coyote; ridden by Gnaw. Secretly own the Seven Fires casino. Their forest is poisoned with Banes. Optional tribe reading: Wendigo (plus one Child of Gaia).
MouseThe Granary (Third Ward cellars), defiledMercer (the last)1
City Garou in human form; Erica’s pack; some helped Merik. Nearly wiped out by the Sabbat and House Goratrix; the caern is dying. Optional tribe reading: Glass Walkers.
The book names its Garou only by totem. The tribe readings are one way to slot them into Werewolf: The Apocalypse; ignore them if you prefer the book’s vaguer Lupines. Real places anchor the zones (the breweries, the concrete Kinnickinnic, the Allen-Bradley clock, the Hoan Bridge, Cedarburg Bog, Holy Hill); every spirit in them is invented.

pg-under-note.title: The underground
pg-under-note.html: The underground is improvised on a real foundation. The sewers, the Miller and Pabst lagering cellars and the Deep Tunnel, still under construction in 1991 three hundred feet under the river beds, are real. The Warrens, the creatures and the Michigan Pocket are not. A red dashed rim marks zones of danger 4–5. Depths shows the lower level: the Deep Tunnel, the vozhd’s lair and Drake’s den.

pg-below.title: Who walks under the city
pg-below.html: Who walks under the city. Mother Agatha rules the Warrens; Ivory watches over the Michigan Pocket. Dragos’s creatures and the last Sabbat pack hide in the southern and western tunnels.

pg-danger.title: The danger scale
pg-danger.html:
0SafeWalk freely
1QuietLocals go unarmed
2WatchfulGo in pairs
3DangerousGo as a squad
4Very dangerousFight your way
5LethalDon’t go

pg-beneath.title: Beneath the pavement
pg-beneath.html: Under Milwaukee lie a century and a half of sewers, lagering cellars and the foundations of demolished buildings. The Nosferatu have always lived here. This autumn they got worse neighbours.

pg-pocket.title: The Michigan Pocket
pg-pocket.html: An impossible cave under the lake, where the sluagh carry the buildings the city has condemned. Two peoples the city didn’t want to see used to meet here. Now the door is shut, and Ivory watches over the Pocket alone.
